title: Ultra-thin-body SOI MOSFET
subtitle: Press ▶ to build the device. Tap a part. Drag to orbit.
steps: A thick buried oxide (BOX) isolates the device.
A thin silicon film forms the channel.
The gate oxide, the gate and the spacers.
The source and drain in the thin film.
Raised source and drain decrease the series resistance.
The scaling rule: tsi is less than or equal to Lg/2.

objects.label: Si substrate
objects.info: The handle silicon wafer. It gives mechanical support. The buried oxide isolates it from the device.

objects.label: buried oxide (BOX)
objects.info: Thick SiO2 (typically 25 nm or more). It isolates the thin silicon film from the substrate, so the source and drain have no junction capacitance to the substrate.

objects.label: thin Si film (tsi)
objects.info: The channel film, thinner than 10 nm in a real device. The film has no free carriers at threshold (fully depleted). No leakage path is far from the gate. Rule: tsi ≤ Lg/2.

objects.label: gate oxide
objects.info: Thin gate oxide. The gate controls the whole thin film through it.

objects.label: gate (Lg)
objects.info: The gate. Its length Lg sets the channel length. A film thinner than Lg/2 keeps short-channel effects small.

objects.label: n+ source (thin)
objects.info: The source in the thin film. The film is very thin, so the source resistance is high.

objects.label: raised source
objects.info: Epitaxial silicon grown on top of the thin source. It makes the source thicker, so its resistance decreases.

objects.label: n+ drain (thin)
objects.info: The drain in the thin film. The film is very thin, so the drain resistance is high.

objects.label: raised drain
objects.info: Epitaxial silicon grown on top of the thin drain. It makes the drain thicker, so its resistance decreases.

objects.label: tsi ≤ Lg/2
objects.info: In SOI, tsi replaces Wdep and Xj in the scaling rules. A film thinner than half the gate length gives good short-channel control.
